body:
📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
Occurrence *#140* (all-time) — surfacing on the every-10th-occurrence rule so it doesn't go invisible. Still `fix_status: investigating`, no Jira after 140 hits.

*runtime-core-api RTC Action Execution p95* spiked to *5.59s* (vs 3s threshold) at 22:12Z Jun 11, with *0 runtime-core error logs* — the textbook latency-only ki-24 signature. Self-recovered.

⚠️ *Two operational notes from this backlog cycle:*
1. *Cron was stuck ~13h* (no poll-cycle 22:12Z Jun 11 → 11:22Z Jun 12; two degraded heartbeats). This cycle recovered the 9-message backlog. Worth checking why the hourly routine stalled.
2. *ki-21 + ki-24 co-fired at ~04:00Z* (≥2 alerts each in 14 min) → precedence_note shared-upstream signal. I investigated the shared upstream and it was *healthy* (ms-account-api 0.076s/0 err, no 5XX, no Redis errors, no gateway errors). The common thread was instead account *`tcg3`* — 55–58% of XHR aborts in *both* frontend windows (04:07Z and 07:42Z), departing from the usual diffuse ki-21 pattern. Looks account-driven, not infra. Worth a glance at what tcg3 was running overnight.

Playbook (KB): 1) confirm pattern via `dd_search.py metric` p95 on `post_/api/v1/runtime/load/_screenid*` — multiple >3s points = pattern. 2) confirm latency-only: `runtime-core-api status:error` returns 0 (✅ confirmed). 3) open https://app.datadoghq.com/apm/traces?query=service%3Aruntime-core-api%20%40duration%3A%3E5s in the spike window, find the slow span (SQL / Mongo / Redis). 4) mitigate: (a) raise monitor to 4s, (b) per-resource circuit breaker, or (c) profile slow accounts + index fixes.
Open Jira: none — overdue after 140 occurrences.

  • DD metric (p95 Action Execution): https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request&exp_scope=env:prod,service:runtime-core-api&exp_agg=p95&start=1781215200000&end=1781216700000
  • Kibana: https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-06-11T22:11:00Z',to:'2026-06-11T22:27:00Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'%22RTC%20Action%20Execution%22%20OR%20%22monitors%2F115456700%22'))  — note: ki-24 ES field-mismatch, 0 backend hits; DD APM canonical.
  • This-window concentration: Action Exec p95 5.59s @22:12Z (latency-only, 0 errors); isolated ki-24 (no ki-21 co-fire within 60 min of this 22:11Z alert).
